methodology: missions created from email ingestion, ratio of D2M-relevant to noise

definition.signal: missions with D2M client/vendor/booking context (client_inquiry, booking_issue, payment, etc.)
definition.noise: missions from classifier false-positives (stock tips, newsletters, political commentary, unsubscribes)

ongoing_tracking.check_command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('OpsCenter/mission_board.json')); m=d.get('missions',[]); print(f'Active: {len([x for x in m if x.get(\"status\") in [\"active\",\"in_progress\"]])}')"
ongoing_tracking.brief_section: Add S/N ratio to daily brief: active missions / archived_noise missions
